title: Magnetline
summary: Puts the download action into 1337x search results, fetching magnet and torrent links for you.
challenge: Put the magnet and .torrent controls into a search result where those links do not exist yet — with no server, no account and no visit to each torrent's own page.
decisions: Resolve each row's links in the background and cache the answers for the list
Both controls are real links, so the browser's own Copy link address works on the magnet
Bounded background prefetch: every request comes from your own browser session
Nothing to run server-side — no server, no account and no telemetry
ownership: Designed and built the extension and its extraction flow end to end.

specimen.caption: Search results — magnet and .torrent in the row

callouts.text: A magnet control and a .torrent control sit right after every result title.
The highlighted row is one whose links have already resolved.
Resolution happens in the background for the rows you are looking at, then gets cached.
